name: swe
description: State-machine workflow engine with Serena memory persistence, hook-driven event architecture, and native subagent parallelization

response_format_enabled.title: Response Format Gate
response_format_enabled.description: Enforce the terse response-format Stop gate (blocks over-long / recap-scaffolded replies). ON by default; set false to opt out per project.

response_format_terse_limit.title: Terse Word Limit
response_format_terse_limit.description: Max prose words in a reply when the user did NOT request detail (prefix a prompt with 'DETAIL:' to license a long answer).

response_format_detail_limit.title: Detail Word Limit
response_format_detail_limit.description: Max prose words when detail was explicitly requested via a leading 'DETAIL:' token.
